text:
acme_dev: getting 400 when invoking function translate_v2 via /v1/functions/invoke. app crashes. payload below, please advise.

acme_dev: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"translate_v2","input":{"text":"Hello","locale":"en-US"},"session_id":"abc123","debug":true}'

sophie_support: thanks — can you paste the full HTTP response body you're seeing? any error id?

acme_dev: response 400 JSON: {
  "error": "json_schema_validation_failed",
  "details": [
    {"path": "/", "keyword": "required", "message": "Missing required property 'session'"},
    {"path": "/", "keyword": "additionalProperties", "message": "Additional properties are not allowed ('debug' was unexpected)"}
  ]
}

sophie_support: ok, escalating to backend. @mike_backend can you triage? customer provided curl + response.

mike_backend: looking. do you have SDK version or are you calling HTTP directly? any proxy/gateway?

acme_dev: node sdk 1.3.2 but we hit same with raw curl. direct public API, no proxy.

deploy-bot: translate_v2 schema update deployed at 2026-02-10T03:21:00Z (release v1.8) — required session object enforced, additionalProperties=false.

mike_backend: that deploy is likely the root cause. schema changed to require a "session" object: {id, user}, and we tightened validation (additionalProperties=false) to avoid silent fields. so two failures: missing required 'session' and 'debug' is an unexpected extra prop.

alex_ml: for compatibility we can either accept legacy top-level session_id and map to session.id, or add a shim that tolerates extra props. prefer an explicit shim for top-level session_id for one release.

emma_product: product aware — we should document breaking change in the changelog and notify customers. file a small compatibility task and note in rollout.

mike_backend: workaround for customer: send payload like: 

  {
    "name":"translate_v2",
    "input":{"text":"Hello","locale":"en-US"},
    "session": {"id":"abc123","user":"acme_user"}
  }

and remove the top-level "debug" flag (or put debug under a top-level "meta" object we allow).

sophie_support: relaying workaround now.

acme_dev: ok updating now...

acme_dev: update: after adding session object and removing debug I get 200 and valid translated text. thank you! :tada:

mike_backend: created ENG-2314 to add temporary mapping of session_id -> session.id and a follow-up ENG-2315 to add docs/changelog. added a note to the release issue about validation strictness.

sophie_support: closing loop with customer. will include example payloads in KB.

acme_dev: appreciate the quick turnaround. please consider a non-breaking deprecation window next time.

emma_product: noted — adding deprecation policy item to the rollout checklist.

mike_backend: marking thread resolved, will keep on ENG-2314 until patch lands.
